items.description: The Drop!in v1.2.3 Mashup helps users locate events that are taking place within the proximity of their locations. The application detects and lists corporate events, social activities, or fun destinations where individuals can visit to engage in past time or work-related activities.
Zvents allows users to discover events by location and type. For active event locations, Zvents leverages the Active.com API.
Gatekrash Mobile is a touchscreen-optimised version of Gatekrash, providing event listings for the UK. It uses the Gatekrash API to request relevant data.
Integration allows MailChimp users to import Eventbrite events and send invitations
Connect your event's Twitter account to Tweetbrite and it will automatically tweet new registrations for your event.
A map of all events around a point in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

Discover upcoming events and stuff to do in a nice and simple interface based on Google Maps. Search for events, narrow down with category, place or date and sort your search by relevance, date, title, popularity or venue name. Mapping Events is powered by Eventful API, Google Maps API, Google AJAX Search API, WorldIP API, Yahoo YQL and Yahoo YUI.
Dynamic map of the Active.com database showing sports related activities such as running events, tennis tournaments, triathlons and highschool sports by location.
Mashup to get nformation about your local events. Uses Eventful and Google Maps.
A visualization of events. Bubbles featuring the most popular art and design events in New York City. Built using the Art Beat API.
Bubbles featuring the most popular art and design events in Tokyo. Built using the ArtBeat API.
GirlFriend X is a web-based little Black Book 2.0 for single guys.
Post and share events for free. Get local event information on your cell phone. Post and share invites. Uses the Eventful API.

Mashup of Google Maps, Virtual Earth with many other APIs. Ext.js is used to make user interface intuitive. It lets you search for hotels, photos, restaurants, wifi spots, local news/blogs, events, weather, and many other spatial data.
Community networking site that allows members to get in touch with their neighbours. The site uses APIs from Nestoria, flickr, Eventful and more to provide local information to users.
Slick podcast app that combines band event data from Eventful with MP3 tracks. Type in a city, get MP3s, discover a band you like, and go see them.
The EVDB (now Eventful) API combined with MS MapPoint creates a mini-map (Feedmap) showing bloggers and events nearby a particular blogger.
Mashup of EVDB event data and Google Maps, with nice calendar browser for paging through search results.

itDuzzit's FreshBooks Notifier lets FreshBooks users send and receive text and email notifications when important events occur, such as when a payment is received, overdue or disputed. Graphical editor lets advanced users create their own custom rule-based notifications for over 60 specific FreshBooks events.
Linda is an artificial intelligence being developed by Basi Technologies that answers a wide variety of user questions. The AI is powered by several APIs and language parsing technology.

Given a company ticker, a user can compute the intrinsic value of a stock using discounted cashflow analysis. All data is retrieved using ThinkNum's API. All Assumptions can be diddled by users as computation is done using JavaScript on client side.
Create a slideshow with voice narration of your Flickr photos.
Allows Box.net users to share content on their LinkedIn profiles. They can choose which files in their Box accounts are visible to LinkedIn contacts.
Browse the latest, most popular, and most highly-rated windsurfing videos from YouTube. Eliminates the hassle of searching through YouTube for good windsurfing videos.

Weather Center is the weather app that has all the data users will ever need. It tracks general weather including summary and detailed forecasts. It also provides users with information on severe weather including storm reports, NWS watches and warnings, storm cell tracking and more.

Download and install this map on your own site. Double-click anywhere on the map for details on that location. Geowalk light is made with Flash. So it is easy to install on other websites. A English, French, Spain, Polish and German Version.
Free PBX for SMS and phone calls with random strangers, while keeping your number and identity private.
You.travel features a cool interactive full-screen map along with travel guides to over 16,000 destinations, traveler reviews, and over 10,000 photos.
Build a Virtual Pin Map of the places you've been.
VidTaggr lets you search taggs and watch videos with realtime trivia, quotes, goofs and more.
Project management application that integrates with Google Tasks. Manage tasks, projects, files, time, expenses, invoices and online payments inside your custom branded app.
Find places to stay via this interactive map. Hotels in London, Ireland, Canada and US.
Mashup of Google Maps, travel products and an XML feed.
It's twitter translated to 40+ languages.
Mac OS X 10 Spotlight plug-in to search del.icio.us
glancemap helps you find or add you missed connection on the map, those people you randomly saw but never had the chance to talk to.
Kinoma Play is a social media browser for smartphones, and this mashup allows Box.net users to access their accounts from within Kinoma.
MapDays allows users to refine event searching by location and time.
Tarpipe is a social media platform that automates the process of discovering and distributing information on multiple web applications, using a visual, workflow oriented interface.
Instantly call everyone in your team using group call and toll-free conference calls for team leaders. Call at any time with no need to schedule, or hold scheduled calls with up to 20 participants.
Trace Michael Jackson's life journey from Gary, Indiana.
TweetaCelebe lists all the verified celebrities and personalities on Twitter and allows users to track their tweet streams and follow them.
Free online rental market facts and analysis service dedicated to helping renters and investors make better rental and investment decisions.
Provides a more user-friendly way to view the comments left on a YouTube video.

Oishii is kind of a del.icio.us mini-zeitgeist. oishii: ephemeral pheromonal del.icio.us-ness. It polls the del.icio.us front page every 5 minutes, and returns all sites bookmarked by at least 30 people.
Connected to Us creates a communication system using the hardware your team members and customers already own.

Calculate your geoposition by address and create geotags, geo-metatags and kml files for your website, weblog or photo. Use a drag-and-drop marker on the result map to optimize your position. NEW: Reverse lookup - Enter a geocoded URL, see its location.

Tools For Etsy is a free service for buyers, sellers and developers built to simplify and enhance the Etsy community experience. Tag Wars, Consolidated Feedback and free advertising are just some of the many tools and resources available.
A Twilio howto where you use Python to ask a caller for a zip code, grab the current weather for that zip code from an RSS feed, and read it back to the caller. All hosted on Google App Engine.
Browse Twitter-trending restaurants and bars in San Francisco, New York, LA and 10 more top Twitter cities.
Google Maps Mashup of vacation and travel information in Germany.

myscenicdrives.com helps users find scenic drives for a casual Sunday afternoon, weekend getaway or adventurous road trip. Each scenic drive features an overview, interactive map, recommended places of interest, weather forecast and GPS directions. Features include the ability to make online travel reservations and a lightweight mobile version for smartphones.
spoonacular is a semantic recipe search engine.
Largest University crime map mashup, covering over 200 universities.

When you listen to music with Audioscrobbler, MusicRambler shows on a map images and events about the artist you are listening to. Enter your Last.FM login and then switch on Audioscrobbler. English version at www.musicrambler.org.
ShooSpy monitors what people are buying on Zappos in realtime.
USA webcams via Google maps. Limited amount of content.
Convert almost any kind of document to PDF.
WordPress plugin that displays classroom projects that need funding on DonorsChoose. The plugin uses the content of your post to attempt to find related classroom projects.
Drawloop's service is an online PDF conversion tool integrated with box.net online storage. It allows you to convert a single file into PDF format or merge multiple files into a single PDF.
Watch sexy Paris Hilton videos collected from YouTube.
A crush system for Facebook. Tell the system who you would like to become better friends with, date, or have a fling with, and if they feel the same way, you'll be sent an e-mail.
UK interactive guide of pubs that serve real ale. Features reviews, visits, photos, and a forum.

A product-rating engine that collects product data, including over 600,000 products and more than 1.6 million reviews through web crawlers and APIs. Giddi runs this data through an algorithm to generate proprietary ratings for each product.
Free HTML5 slideshows from Facebook, Flickr, Photobucket, Smugmug, Picasa, Youtube (as soundtrack music) and SlideshowBox HTML5 slideshow component.

TaskClone is the missing link to your productivity; automatically sending Evernote to-dos to your task management app(s) or Google Calendar. Works on all Evernote platforms, with over 50 tasks apps supported.
This is a Google Widget that shows festivals and events in the localities of in Kerala and Tamilnadu, India.
You select your desired locations, such as all of the cities you have lived in, then the map will display all of your cities along with the exact midpoint for those places.

Refinansiere.net is a Norwegian portal which compares rates and terms on various refinancing offers. That includes annual percentage rates, downpayment times and various miscellaneous costs charged by each lender. Numbers are fetched through the API of Finansportalen, a portal run by the Norwegian government through which bank and finance institutions upload their data. Refinansiere.net seeks to help consumers make the right financial choice, based on their individual financial situation.
Sportmeets connects online users who love sports so that they can meet, organize their teams and events and compete offline.
Apartment finding service for Chicago, The Homestead Group. Uses the Peekacity API.
Natural hot and mineral springs across the United States. Interactive maps, user reviews and GPS coordinates for each listing.

FACEinHOLE uses Printfection to show each user what their custom FACEinHOLE looks like on a t-shirt and merchandise, with the option to purchase and checkout through Printfection. The entire experience is white-labeled.
A Google Maps mashup that allows you to mark places of interest, add reviews, and share your favorite locations with others.
Flickr screensaver for Windows XP
A Twitter Trends dashboard that, at a glance, shows you whatâ€™s happening across geographyâ€™s using trending topics on Twitter.
Online aromatherapy shop created using Shopping API. Price comparison with direct product links to stores. Aromtherapy.eu has subdomains for US, DE, FR, and AU. Main domain used for UK Shopping API.
Fertility calculator that also integrates with Google Calendar.

Rent Compass is a Google maps mashup to find apartments for rent in major Canadian cities like Toronto, Ottawa, Edmonton or Vancouver. The site uses Ajax to change the layout and works with as little clicks as possible, we also built the mashup to display hundreds of apartment/house pins on the map without compromising performance. Rent Compass also developed the first Canadian apartment rentals search applications for mobile devices; namely the iPhone, iPad and Google Android. Since we are obsessed with performance we made our mobile apps super fast as well, with focus on ease of usability. That's why our users love them and give great reviews. We also license our platform to other industries or geographic locations.
itDuzzit enables developers and non-developers alike to build Twilio-powered voice and SMS applications without coding.
Iran Election Protest Tweets from Middle East, Europe, Eastern and Western United States
Intelligent agents based marketspace constantly aggregating top deals and rebates for a wide range of products.
See the recipients of Stimulus Dollars in your state. Replace the 2 letter state code at the end of the URL with your state code.
iHear Network for Android lets you hear what people are saying in your neighborhood or you can teleport to a different location and hear what's going on there.

Italianwinesandfood.com is a mashup project to promote the best of Italian products, but also wine tours in Italy. In a easy-to-use map we collected the main typical Italian products divided by types and geographic locations. In particular our purpose is enabling a rapid and intuitive consultation of the map to discover the typical Italian products and the main Italian wines.

Notwilfications is a Google Chrome Extension that shows you when a call comes in and allows you to either ignore it or send it to voicemail, without ever having to pick up your phone to know who's calling.

Not for the easily offended. William and Kate have just completed their wedding vows and are standing outside the Abbey, surrounded by onlookers, and appear to be unaware of the oncoming zombie hordes. Undercover agents and body guards are scattered throughout the crowd, however they are greatly outnumbered... Watch how it all unfolds in Binary Space's game, Class 3 Outbreak.

Mashup showing locations of 200 places mentioned in the Bible. Going for accuracy they try to pinpoint the locations of the ruins of ancient cities instead of using the locations of modern cities with ancient names.
Run your own shop with this store in a box. Powered by the Commission Junction API gives it millions of products.
Search San Francisco Bay Area real estate listings on a map. Currently tracking over 36000+ listings in 157 cities in the bay area.
Mashup on PhotoEnforced.com that plots the location of Red Light cameras in the Los Angeles area. There are also maps for other areas, including Northern California, San Diego, and Washington DC.

An easy way to create music playlists from songs and videos available on youtube. No ads before a video starts. Save and manage playlists, share them with others and find new albums in the user-created database.
This map displays how many Prezi users are collaborating across the world at any one time. This powerful visualization is displayed using Google Maps.
Stay connected with your friends and contacts in your social networks on the go. Vodafone Update provides mobile access to Twitter, Facebook and MySpace, combined in a single UI.
A 360 degree panorama journey through Prague. Over 400 locations and 800 panoramas. Now with navigation in 18 languages.
KnowledgeTreeLive is a hosted, on-demand edition of the KnowledgeTree Document Management Software to manage documents, secure documents, and collaborate.
Google map of the new North Carolina greenway which connects Umstead park and Lake Crabtree trails to the Raleigh greenway system. Includes markers to access Flickr photos, descriptions, news, etc.
Search and watch free Bangla music video songs, Bangla Natoks, Bangladesh models, actors, actresses, Bangladesh movies, Bengali drama serials, Bangladesh news, TV shows, sports and more.
Toronto Live Club Hub helps locals and visitors find out where to find live music in the Toronto area via maps and integrated links to club listings.
Uses PHP and xslt to transform RSS feeds from Flickr into thumbnailed HTML pages. See demo and download code to run it on your own site.

Find out where your facebook friends are located around the world. See who else is staying in your city and country. Filter your friends by country and exact location as updated in Facebook. View your friends statistics by location and gender.
Interactive bike routing by intersection for the city of Chicago.
Amazon books combined with Windows Live Local. It allows users to find books on Amazon based upon geographical locations around the world.

Agent locator using the ST_INTERSECTS statement of Google Fusion Tables. The Application shows the location of estate agents that speak english located in france. It displays this information on a map with a radius.
An auto-tagging service that allows sites to add their own tag clouds.

A collection of full-page image scans of the newspaper from 1851–1922. Organized chronologically and navigated by a simple calendar interface, TimesMachine provides a unique way to traverse the historical archives of The New York Times.
A large collection of placemarks from all around the world. See multiple satellite views, birds eye view, Google Earth and photo galleries. Get directions to popular locations.
Uses Google Maps and Twitter APIs to show where your Twitter followers are coming from and what they're interested in.
DBStract is a free web app and database builder.
Use this interactive Flash-based app to browse EA's Spore creatures to decide how will you browse the Universe.
Location guide to football clubs in the top 16 divisions of English Football. Covers the Premier League, Football League & the top twelve divisions in non-league football.

Adtegrity is a digital advertising solutions provider that delivers cross-screen advertising solutions for mobile video ads. Adtegrity's services include content strategizing, customers targeting, data optimizing and analysis.
650+ data series from the Federal Reserve, US economic data in a navigable timeline with landmark events.

CheckinSpy lets you view the places that you and your friends have checked in, using Google Street View. You can look at recent checkins that you or your friends have posted, or search for a specific friend.
Ask Vox is a community question and answer website, where users teach Vox, the website character, to answer questions with voice.

This mashup visualizes Twitter data collected during the 2011 NCAA basketball tournament using the Twitter Streaming API. For each matchup in the bracket, the map lights up one team's colors based on the amount of tweets recieved at each location. Send a geotagged tweet to support your favorite team!
Shows exponentially smoothed flu trends in Sweden based on self-reported health in Twitter messages.
The Social Local Web Scan Plugin for your website.

Lets you use any phone to catch up on the most popular topics on Twitter, even when you can't get online. Without signing up, you can call Howdy to hear the top 10 current trends, with an explanation of each.
Share photos on Twitter with TwitPic.
Malta hotels with integrated map of YouTube videos.
A dynamic network feed of geo-tagged Flickr photos in Google Earth.
CareSteps – Robust, Paperless Business Solutions it provides versatile and paperless mobile business solutions that reduce your business cost and improve online market visibility. Go paperless today!
The first Self-Referential Tumblr. Your page accesses are our posts. A mashup of Tumblr and Clicky.
Italian real estate mashup using Google Maps with geolocation, map search, announcement images and location view, satellite zoom, and RSS feeds.
Map shows locations of cities ranked as having the best quality of living.
Italian public jobs search engine and map. The jobs are grabbed from the Gazzetta Ufficiale.
Simple apps to search a job for Indonesian.
Vreetings is a video-plus-greetings service for creating video greeting cards using a drag-and-drop technique. The videos that you drag are YouTube videos.
iGoogle gadget that displays price, quote, and fundamentals of one of the latest winners.
Start a mailrace on a Google map.
Fast, simple vacation rental search. Listings from HomeAway, FlipKey, and AirBnB laid out on Google Maps
Watch the internet as it's being uploaded. Every 10 seconds it grabs the newest public photo from Flickr.
A mashup of the Most Livable States of America based on Livablity Rating, which is the average of state rankings in 44 different factors.
Jorg Pfeiffer is on a road trip from Berlin to Southeastern Europe for the German magazine Der Spiegel. Users can post ideas on what topics to cover and places to visit. In German.

A music discovery tool built on Bandcamp and Last.fm. Browse through and listen to Bandcamp's extensive catalog of independent music with intelligent recommendations powered by Last.fm. For existing Last.fm members, it scrobbles your listens, provides personalized recommendations, and submits your loved tracks.
Monitor anything important to you on the web with SMS - track classifieds postings, job boards, RSS feeds. If you own a business, track new orders, purchases, sign ups, etc.
Add the Emoface iGoogle Gadget of the day to your website or iGoogle Homepage.
Create photo slideshows with music. Site allows you to add Flash to flickr, myspace, xanga, and Blogger
YourTraces is a people search engine that traces biographies available online. Most of the site is in German.
Your condo or apartment can now go solar!

TextSlide is a private community that connects users for one-on-one conversations about anything and delivers them via SMS. Your phone number is never exposed to anyone. The only thing others see are your name, area code and interests. Your interests are used as an ice breaker.

A guide for Red Sox fans visiting Ft Myers, Florida for spring training. Created with the Atlas mapping tool. Fans can plot photos on a satellite image of City of Palms Park and comment on businesses found via Google Local Search.
With this App you can synchronize your Google Contacts to be part of you network on Tradeshift
Jigsaw is a puzzle game automatically generated from the most interesting Flickr photos of the day.

Pricemachine is an automated price comparison tool. Users can automatically log regularly purchased items from online or loyalty card purchases. PriceMachine can then find the cheapest place to buy the same items. This mashup uses the Information Machine API.
Twups is a twitter aggregator, pulling the most popular twitter topics into one place, so you can keep up to date on what is going on in the world, via twitter.
Watch new photos being uploaded to Flickr in real time. Uses Ajax.

Find commercial real estate with Coldwell Banker Commercial maps. Combines the listings of CBC with a full screen auto resizing map in the background powered by Virtual Earth. You can draw your own polygons for search as well.
Guide to Bed and Breakfasts and hotels in France.
Organise your hen night or bachelorette party with free invitations, add Google map route-planning and directions, and create photo albums with pictures from your computer or mobile phone.
TapAMap is a mobile mashup between a zoomable full-world satellite map and Wikipedia. Users simply do a half-second touch on a location to see up to five nearby Wikipedia articles

A mash up of a broadband checker, Google Maps and Yahoo AJAX. Maps the distance to your exchange and calculates the speed of an ADSL connection as shows a list of broadband providers in the area. NOTE: Jan 07 appears down.

Click4Support provides a broad array of services for its customers from PC repair for virus removal in Essex, CT, US with customers in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada. Click4Support uses the SupportFu API.
This mashup allows Box.net users to load spreadsheet files directly from their Box accounts into EditGrid, where they can be viewed and edited, then saved back to a Box account.
Forums connected to a map. Mark a place and then type a question. In other words create an initiation for a discussion and get a unique link for the map.

moTube is a mobile subscription service that allows people to receive notifications via text message (SMS/MMS) each time a new video is published to a YouTube channel. We created moTube as a way for people to get realtime updates from their favorite YouTube channels directly on their phone. It's a free service and we don't charge subscribers for the notifications sent to their device. Keep in mind that the text messaging plan you have with your mobile carrier still applies. For example, if you have an unlimited messaging plan and receive an update from moTube, you will not be charged anything. moTube is currently in beta, so YouTubers who want to add moTube to their channel must have an invite which we're currently accepting requests for on our website (http://motube.us/).
Shows on a Google Map the top 10 cities from Google Trends for a given keyword search. Includes 100 top keywords within the hour.
An interactive map to find and add ping pong tables worldwide. For the animation, jQuery was used. The app is optimized for iPhone/iPod Touch as well.
Contextualizing and situating the list of prisons and the human rights abuses in Tunisia. Mashup of database data with Google Maps, YouTube, Flash animations and Yahoo Q Beta search.

EmbeddedAnalytics enables Google Analytics reports to be embedded into web pages for the world to see. No programming knowledge is required. Embed the reports into blogs, websites, mobile websites, and anywhere an iframe tag is supported.
Shared Count is a small utility that will fetch social media shares for a url

Audience Partners is an enterprise advertising management company that focuses on on healthcare, politics and public affairs. With the Audience Partners platform, customers will be able to micro-target different messages to different audience segments in order to increase engagement and return on their advertisement.
A mashup combining the JavaScript effects ImageFlow and Highslide JS with the YouTube API. With YouFlow you can search all the YouTube videos, browse them with ImageFlow and open them with Highslide.
Explore the Caribbean island of Barbados via Google Maps with nearly 300 points including beaches, accommodation, places of interest, golf courses and dive sites.

Sunday Morning Rides is an interactive community portal for motorcycle riders to access, explore, plan, and share motorcycle tracks via a ride mapping system that combines GPS, geographic information systems, database, and Google mapping technologies.
Provides tracking information of FedEx packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
Compare new homes, home designs, builders, land estate, house plans, via Google Maps in Australia.
Maps, videos, photos, news, social networking for the action sports community for riders, skateboarding, snowboarding, skiing, surfing, bmx, mountain biking, motocross and wakeboarding.
Thanks to PayPal, users can donate money to help friends in times of need.
Allows IT professionals to compare information about salary, job skills, and roles based on location. It also gives you an idea of demand based on the number of IT jobs advertised.
ScreenSvr is a simple screen saver for Windows PCs. It grabs photos from Flickr, based on your selection criteria, and displays them in a repeating slideshow as a screensaver.

LOCPix allows searching and viewing of the digitized photo collections from the Library of Congress. Browse collections or search the vast archive for interesting historical photographs and poster artwork. Hundreds of thousands of images are available, many in high resolution.
SafetyGrid is a personal emergency alert system for mobile devices. Receive alerts via telephone, SMS message, Facebook or email. Currently available on iPhone and iPad.

A map mashup for the Gold Coast of Queensland Australia, showing accommodation and attractions. Simple application using custom icons, single xml file, selectable grouping. Aims are to build the map content via user submission to the forum on the site.
YouTubeMP4 creates a link to the mpeg4 file on YouTube from the YouTube URL. You can download the file quickly by directly downloading it from YouTube.
Sales Tracker is a product built around organizations who want their field sales team to report there daily sales via SMS.
Prank my friend shows the power of mashups. This time for bad.
TweetTest is a collection of six mini games that use data from your and your friend’s public Tweets.

School Performance Maps provides a bird's eye view of public school performance in California. Data from California Department of Education, Academic Performance Index. The 1-10 is statewide rank school, low to high.

Music Updated helps you stay up to date with the music you like. It's like a twitter newsfeed, but dedicated to music news and upcoming albums based on the artists you follow. It acquires some of this information by leveraging the Last.fm and YouTube APIs.
A Minecraft mod that adds tracking of carbon emissions using AMEE.
A ThinkUp-powered dashboard tracking 125 federal government agencies on Twitter. We rank which federal agencies are doing the best job of engaging their audiences on social media through Twitter.
This Google Maps mashup shows countries through which the equator passes.
MyKorea is a kind of a shell which can display every geospatial data concerning Korea I am interested in.

WebServicesPros provide automation between Americommerce shopping cart and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems through the use of AC API Web Services and different ERP and Accounting Softwares. The WebServicesPros Desktop application serves as an intermediary application to bridge the two systems as well as provide additional features to both ends when they are not present. The configurable and customized solutions allow several different shopping carts or even different cart providers to integrate while assisting the back office by making the process efficient and seamless from the accounting and fulfillment point of view.
A time tracking solution that integrates with online project collaboration software including Basecamp and Blinksale.
Search real estate in Valencia, Spain. The agency specializes in investment real estate and management.
The local information you want.

Create a personalised dashboard of line charts to keep an eye on the UK economy. The page uses a PHP script to scrape time-series data CSVs from the Office for National Statistics website each day and add them to a MySQL database. Two more PHP scripts provide data to the page in JSON format.
Google Mashup of EVDO network coverage, as reported by users in the field. Visitors can see where Sprint and Verizon EVDO coverage performs well, and where it does not.
Karaoke2U is the user and YouTube powered content site for your Karaoke Videos. All Video is submitted and voted on by the Karaoke2U community. Share, watch and promote your Karaoke Videos.
Provides links to relevant pages using the Glue API, creating a one stop site for researching a movie.
UK site with Google Maps to help find dine-in and takeaway food. Menus and readers reviews online to peruse.
MP3 Search directory with information on each artist and genre.

CreditorWatch is an online community of Australian businesses who share information about bad debtors. Helps businesses make better credit decisions and provides members an extra tool to recover outstanding debts prior to engaging in collections or legal action.
Japanese site lets you search YouTube videos classified by age and category like music, games, and anime.
A Pentomino Puzzle. It is created by using the OpenLayers Mapping API. Move, rotate and reflect the 12 pieces to find a solution for the rectangles layout.
